stories.title: Festival CRSSD anuncia a programação da primavera de 2027
stories.summary: CRSSD Festival has announced its spring 2027 lineup for 13–14 March 2027 at Waterfront Park, San Diego, across three stages: Ocean View, City Steps and The Palms. Names include Eric Prydz, Adam Beyer, Sven Väth, Indira Paganotto, Ellen Allien b2b Marcel Dettmann, Dubfire b2b Nicole Moudaber, Maceo Plex, DJ Heartstring and Josh Baker. The article puts Portuguese techno act ØTTA in the underground/eclectic section and calls them 'a força do techno português'.

stories.title: Exclusive: Jason Isbell Dramatically Expands Suno Class Lawsuit to 20 Litigants
stories.summary: Jason Isbell and David Lowery have amended their class action against AI music company Suno, expanding it to 20 plaintiffs, including Natalie Maines and David Longstreth. The suit is about name, image and likeness rights. It now targets Suno's September 2026 v6, v6-mini and v6-wild models and rebuts Suno's 'licensed-only' defence. It also cites Q3 2026 data on AI tracks flooding streaming services and Suno's distribution deal with Believe/TuneCore.

stories.title: Benjamin Clementine arranca em Braga digressão com 13 concertos em Portugal
stories.summary: Benjamin Clementine has announced 'Back to Basics', a solo piano tour that opens on 1 April 2027 at Fórum Braga and ends on 30 May in Bilbao. It has 13 Portuguese dates, including Porto, Lisbon, Viana do Castelo, Faro, Coimbra and the Azores. Tickets go on sale Friday, 27 November. This is the story behind the 'benjamin clementine' Google Trends spike in Portugal, but it is not electronic music.

stories.title: Tidal vai eliminar do catálogo a música gerada inteiramente por inteligência artificial
stories.summary: From 9 December, Tidal will remove fully AI-generated tracks and stop accepting new ones. Music where AI only assisted a human artist is still allowed. About 6% of its catalogue (around 27 million tracks) carries its AI label, and the label hit an average of 43% of new uploads over the past 90 days, going above 60% on 6 November. Suno accounts for 94% of flagged tracks, 96% of which had no plays in 90 days. Tidal expects to reject 80,000 to 85,000 songs a day and wants the affected tracks gone by early 2027.

stories.title: PMDS e Mão Morta com João Barradas e Mariana Vilanova no Som Riscado'26: à imagem da música
stories.summary: A review of Som Riscado'26 in Loulé. It covers the Portuguese electronic duo PMDS (Pedro Sousa and Filipe Caetano), who played the Sunday matinee at mákina.b with tracks from their 2026 album 'Redenção'. They played modular synths and vintage keyboards alongside visuals ranging from 8mm film to recent footage. One track, 'Ausência', reworks a traditional Azorean melody.

stories.title: Rachael Pazdan named New York's first executive director of music
stories.summary: Rachael Pazdan, formerly music director at Le Poisson Rouge and a booker at public records, The Bell House and Baby's All Right, is New York City's first executive director of music. The new role sits in the Mayor's Office of Media and Entertainment. Her job includes making live performances easier to organise and opening music industry careers to young New Yorkers. Her appointment follows Eric Thor's as director of the city's Office of Nightlife.
